County Home / Records Search
Fairfield County Records Search
Search county records online — real estate, court cases, public records, probate, land records, and more. Each link opens an official search portal in a new tab.
Records search portals
These links lead to official portals operated by individual county offices and partner systems. You are leaving the county home site when you open them.
Real Estate Search
Search parcel ownership, valuations, sales history, and property records through the Auditor’s real-estate portal.
Search
Common Pleas Case Inquiry
Public access to Common Pleas civil and criminal court case information. Accuracy is not guaranteed; some records are not viewable online.
Search
Public Records Requests
Submit a records request to the Clerk of Courts Records Division — in person, by phone, or online.
Search
Municipal Court Search
Dockets and case search for the Fairfield County Municipal Court.
Search
Probate Records Search
Search hearing and court records held by the Probate Court.
Search
Ohio Land Records
Search recorded deeds, mortgages, and land documents from the County Recorder’s Office.
Search
Adoptable Dogs
Browse dogs currently available for adoption at the County Dog Adoption Center & Shelter.
Search
